title: The Silent Library
intro:
You wake up in a worn leather armchair. Candles flicker. Rows of old books surround you — you are in **The Silent Library**, and the only door is locked.

Explore the room, find clues and escape. Type what you want to do, e.g. *"examine the desk"*, *"take the note"*, *"enter 123 on the drawer"*, *"use key on painting"*. Type **hint** if you are stuck.
room_description: A dim private library at night. You can see an oak desk with a drawer, a tall bookshelf, a portrait painting, an antique globe, a grandfather clock and a heavy oak door with a keypad.

desk.name: oak desk
desk.description: A heavy oak writing desk covered in dust. A handwritten note lies on top. The desk has a single drawer.

bookshelf.name: bookshelf
bookshelf.description: Floor-to-ceiling shelves. Three red books stand out: 'Seven Silent Sisters' (medium height), 'One Lonely Lighthouse' (the shortest) and 'Four Winter Roads' (the tallest).

drawer.name: desk drawer
drawer.description_locked: The drawer is locked with a 3-digit combination lock.

painting.name: painting
painting.description_locked: A portrait of the late librarian, Madame Elsa Vogel. Looking closely, you notice a tiny keyhole hidden in the gilded frame.
painting.description_open: The painting has swung open on a hinge, revealing a small niche in the wall.

globe.name: globe
globe.description: An antique globe. There are faint, strange smudges on the oceans, as if someone wrote on it with invisible ink.
globe.description_revealed: Under the UV light, glowing words appear on the ocean: 'When I left, the little hand pointed to nine and the big hand to eight.'

clock.name: grandfather clock
clock.description: A tall grandfather clock. Its hands have been removed. Engraved below the face: 'Time is a door.'

door.name: door
door.description_locked: A heavy oak door. It is locked by a 4-digit keypad.
door.description_open: The door stands open. Fresh night air flows in.

note.name: handwritten note
note.description: The note reads: 'My dear reader — the red books keep my secret. Read them from the shortest to the tallest.'

brass_key.name: brass key
brass_key.description: A small, ornate brass key. It looks too small for the door.

uv_flashlight.name: UV flashlight
uv_flashlight.description: A small flashlight that emits violet ultraviolet light.

drawer_code.description: Find the 3-digit drawer code from the red books and the note.
drawer_code.success: The combination lock clicks. The drawer slides open. Inside lies a small brass key.

painting_key.description: Unlock the hidden keyhole in the painting frame.
painting_key.success: The brass key turns with a soft click. The painting swings open, revealing a niche with a UV flashlight inside.

globe_message.description: Reveal the invisible writing on the globe.
globe_message.success: Under the UV light, glowing words appear on the ocean: 'When I left, the little hand pointed to nine and the big hand to eight.'

door_code.success: The keypad beeps twice and the lock releases. The heavy door swings open — you step out into the cool night air. You escaped!

hints.text: The note on the desk talks about red books. Look at the bookshelf — the titles and heights matter.
Keys open keyholes. Have you looked closely at the painting?
Some writing can only be seen in a special kind of light. Which object looks like it was written on?
The clock has no hands, but the globe told you where they were. Turn that time into four digits.
